_about: v2.4 plan 06 T17.5. Labels frozen 2026-09-25 before findSpanFuzzy existed. tau = 0.8 per side, declared in the plan. Floor: 0 false matches over the negatives (a positive matched to the wrong span also counts as false). Positives report the lift only.
_corrections: 2026-09-25, after the first run: p07 and p11 were mislabelled. Their anchors quote the leading 'the', which the content holds ('The inn's cellar', 'The twins'), and the frozen span left it out. The span now starts at that word. No negative, no threshold and no rule was changed. The same run found a real defect on p01/p08 (the match dropped the anchor's own first word); the fix is edge snapping in fuzzy.ts, not a label change.
